# A synthetic fragment of IdnaMappingTable.txt, for the generator's unit test. Not Unicode's data. It must still
# cover every code point, in order, as the real table does.

0000..002C    ; disallowed_STD3_valid                  # <control-0000>..COMMA
002D..002E    ; valid                                  # HYPHEN-MINUS..FULL STOP
002F          ; disallowed_STD3_valid                  # SOLIDUS
0030..0039    ; valid                                  # DIGIT ZERO..DIGIT NINE
003A..0040    ; disallowed_STD3_valid                  # COLON..COMMERCIAL AT
0041          ; mapped                 ; 0061          # LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A
0042          ; mapped                 ; 0062          # LATIN CAPITAL LETTER B
0043..0060    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
0061..007A    ; valid                                  # LATIN SMALL LETTER A..LATIN SMALL LETTER Z
007B..00AC    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
00AD          ; ignored                                # SOFT HYPHEN
00AE..00DE    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
00DF          ; deviation              ; 0073 0073     # LATIN SMALL LETTER SHARP S
00E0..00FF    ; valid                  ;      ; NV8    # synthetic
0100..0101    ; valid                                  # synthetic
0102..0131    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
0132..0133    ; mapped                 ; 0069 006A     # LATIN CAPITAL LIGATURE IJ..LATIN SMALL LIGATURE IJ
0134..1E9D    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
1E9E          ; mapped                 ; 0073 0073     # LATIN CAPITAL LETTER SHARP S
1E9F..200B    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
200C..200D    ; deviation              ;               # ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER..ZERO WIDTH JOINER
200E..2473    ; disallowed                             # synthetic
2474          ; disallowed_STD3_mapped ; 0028 0031 0029 # PARENTHESIZED DIGIT ONE
2475..10FFFF  ; disallowed                             # synthetic
